Careers

Join our team

FirstPoint, a startup at the intersection of cyber and cellular communications, provides cellular cybersecurity solutions to protect the world’s most critical communications for IoT devices and mobile phones. Our team is exceptionally diverse. We believe in a family-friendly and flexible work environment. Or as one of our employees put it, “this is the best organizational culture I’ve experienced”. We appreciate teamwork, agility, and a can-do attitude. Come meet the team, and you’ll see what we mean.
